Name: ZZ-TEST seed tag
Purpose: The ownership marker. A OneLogin user has no description to carry one, so the seed creates this field, writes the tag into it on every user, and teardown removes it last

Name: ZZ-TEST badge id
Purpose: An identifier outside the directory's own, absent on some users, so a report has to cope with a field that is simply empty

Name: ZZ-TEST contractor
Purpose: A boolean stored as text, because OneLogin fields are text. The string false is not falsy in PowerShell, so anything casting this rather than comparing it reads every person as a contractor

Name: ZZ-TEST cost center
Purpose: A value shared by whole departments, which a mapping or report can group on
